From: Mete Polat <cl-isabelle-users@lists.cam.ac.uk>

Hi,

This crashes in Isabelle 2026 and I think it also does in earlier versions:

theory Scratch
imports Main
begin

simproc_setup congproc p ("id id True") = ‹K (K (K (SOME @{lemma "id id True ≡ True" by simp})))›

lemma "id id True" by simp

end

exception THM 0 raised (line 1534 of "thm.ML"):
transitive: middle term
id id True ≡ True
id id True ≡ id True

Best,
Mete

From: Peter <cl-isabelle-users@lists.cam.ac.uk>

Hi Mete

Did you really mean to declare a congproc? "id id True ≡ True" is not a
typical congruence rule.

--

Peter
